tagline.zh: 两只小红松鼠追着偷橡果的乌鸦穿过巨大的人类世界：举起一切，砸回去。
tagline.en: Two small red squirrels chase the crow that stole their acorns through a giant human world: lift anything, throw it back.

desc.en: Finish a run, however it ends.

desc.zh: 用吐司打败厨房里的暴脾气烤面包机。
desc.en: Beat the toaster in the kitchen with its own toast.

desc.zh: 打败偷果鸦，夺回过冬的橡果。
desc.en: Beat the acorn crow and take the winter stash back.
Win a run without a continue.

desc.zh: 在一局里找到四个秘密洞穴。
desc.en: Find four secret burrows in one run.
Win a run with two players.

desc.zh: 在一局里把队友扔出去砸中 3 个敌人。
desc.en: Knock out 3 enemies in one run by throwing your partner at them.

desc.zh: 在一局里收集 250 颗橡果。

how.zh: 一只乌鸦偷走了小枫和大栗过冬的橡果。在地图上选路线，穿过厨房、玩具店、下水道和树屋，每个地方打完两关再打败首领。走到箱子、苹果、积木、螺母、核桃旁按「举起」，再按一次直线扔出去，砸中的第一个敌人一下就飞；按住上再扔是向上砸。举着东西按住下就躲在它下面，撞上来的敌人会被弹晕，晕了的敌人能举起来扔；跳到敌人头上也能把它踩晕。按住下再按「举起」把东西放在面前，叠起来当台阶。双人时可以举起队友扔出去，队友飞出去不会受伤。木箱里藏着橡果、红心或金橡果；每收集 50 颗橡果加一条命；裂开的墙和闪光的洞后面有秘密房间。首领只怕自己扔下或吐出来的东西：接住它，趁首领露出破绽时扔回去，三个阶段后就倒下。红心用完失去一条命，所有玩家没有生命时用一次续关重来这一关；没有续关则失败，打败偷果鸦即通关。
how.en: A crow has stolen Fenn and Tug's winter acorns. Pick a path on the map through the kitchen, the toy shop, the sewer and the treehouse: two levels in each place, then its boss. Stand by a crate, apple, toy block, nut or walnut and press Lift; press again to throw it in a straight line, and the first enemy it hits is knocked out at once. Hold Up to throw it upwards. Hold Down while carrying to hide under it: enemies that run into it bounce off dizzy, and a dizzy enemy can be lifted and thrown; jumping on an enemy dazes it too. Hold Down and press Lift to set a thing down in front of you, and stack things into steps. With two players you can lift your partner and throw them; a thrown partner is not hurt. Wooden crates hide acorns, hearts and golden acorns; every 50 acorns give an extra life, and cracked walls and glinting holes lead to secret rooms. A boss is only hurt by what it throws or drops itself: catch it and throw it back when the boss is open, and after three phases it falls. Losing every heart costs a life; when every player is out of lives a continue restarts the level, and with no continue left the run is lost. Beat the acorn crow to win.

name.zh: 移动 / 上扔 / 躲藏
举起 / 投掷 / 放下

note.zh: 影响红心、生命、续关次数、敌人的速度和首领的体力。
note.en: Changes hearts, lives, continues, how fast enemies are and how tough the bosses are.

screenshot_alt.zh: 《搬箱小队》双人局内画面：灯光下的工具台上，围青色围巾的红松鼠小枫把木箱举过头顶，围橙色围巾的棕松鼠大栗跟在它身旁，前方一只紫色甲虫机器正爬过来。
screenshot_alt.en: Crate Crew with two players: on the lamp-lit workbench Fenn, the red squirrel with the teal scarf, holds a wooden crate over its head with Tug, the brown squirrel with the orange scarf, beside it, and a purple beetle machine crawls towards them.

art_alt.zh: 《搬箱小队》主视觉：巨大的厨房台面上，一只红松鼠把木箱举过头顶，另一只跃起扔出苹果，窗外一只黑乌鸦叼着装满橡果的布袋飞走。
art_alt.en: Crate Crew key art: on a giant kitchen counter one red squirrel heaves a wooden crate overhead while the other leaps to throw an apple, and outside the window a black crow flies off with a cloth sack of acorns.
